title: Datasets this site may cite for personnel fields
rules: An entry here is a claim we can defend about a dataset we hold. Adding one without the artifact in hand is a fabricated citation.

retrievedAt is the date the SOURCE produced or published the data, attested by the source. The date we downloaded, processed or loaded a file is not this field. Leave it null when we hold no attestation and let the class fall to source_and_dataset_verified.

fields lists what the dataset is capable of sourcing. A field absent from this list cannot be cited to this dataset even if a row claims it — which is how badge number stays uncitable to a production that has no badge column.

attestations.notes: One Texas Public Information Act production, not a scrape. Workbook PublicInformationRequest_2025-02-10_1410.xlsx, 16,983,932 bytes, four sheets: Departments 3,906, Officers 129,973, Services 170,754, OfficersLicensesActions 189,629. The hash above was recomputed on 2026-10-24 and matches the recorded manifest. recordsRequestId is null because no request letter, response letter or tracking number has been preserved — the only identifier we hold is the production filename, which is not an identifier the agency would recognise. retrievedAt is null because the manifest records processed_at_utc 2026-05-07, the date we processed the file, not the date TCOLE produced it; INS-64 owns preserving the correspondence that would supply both. The Officers sheet carries PUBLIC_GUID, FNAME, MNAME, LNAME and SFX only — no date of birth, address, government identifier or internal personnel id. No badge-number column exists in any sheet.
